title: FindingReport
description: Confirmed bugs in live code. Every finding includes the exact trigger condition and root cause.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the workspace root

language.description: Primary language of the scanned code (e.g. rust, typescript)

modules_scanned.description: Modules or files included in the scan (live code only)

dead_files_excluded.description: Files excluded because they are unreachable from the crate root or entry point

trigger_condition.description: Exact input, state, or call sequence that reproduces the bug

remediation_sketch.description: One-sentence description of the fix — not prescriptive code

verdict.description: confirmed = adversary could not refute; plausible = needs human review
